title: eumachia cephalantha
intro: Eumachia cephalantha, commonly known as the 'tree of life' or 'ironwood', is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is a tropical plant native to the island of Madagascar, valued for its medicinal properties and traditional use in folk medicine. The health benefits of Eumachia cephalantha include its potential to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids and phenolic compounds, which also exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antiparasitic activities.
